title: Reading vector
description: A test vector of reading (section 7 of the deployment text): files of a deployment configuration, each with the origin where app is open and what section 5 gives. A reader implements section 5 and gets exactly this.

origin.description: The origin where app is open, as the URL Standard serializes it.

file.description: The file as JSON reads it: any JSON value, not only one the schema accepts.

refused_by.description: The step that refuses the file: the schema, or the ID of the rule. Left out when the reader accepts the file.

items.description: A field's path: the names from the root, joined by a dot; the empty path for the root.

fields.description: Every field that step refuses, in the order of code units.
